searchText: It would be convenient if you could say how many hours/minutes until the meeting in these posts so people don't have to try to do time zone conversions. Discord messages include local timestamps, so if you say "in 23 hours" I can just look at the timestamp in discord and add 23 hours to get my local time. <@!301186049323958275> - UTC is our friend 😉 There are a lots of world clocks to do conversions. https://discord.bots.gg/bots/447266583459528715 Yeah, I can do the conversion for myself certainly. Easier for me than Americans since I live in a sane country that doesn't do daylight savings stuff. However, it would be a minor convenience if it was included in the post. My thinking here is that the effort required for Pooja to give a "number of hours/minutes from now" is quite low (likely on-par with the effort required for me to do the conversion myself), but when you consider that *every* reader of the message has to do the conversion that extra effort be the author is likely "worth it" in terms of net productivity. Certainly not a hard requirement, just a minor point of feedback. https://top.gg/bot/323161971102973963 I find UTC much more helpful - an unambiguous standard. The two bots above I found with a quick Google. The second looks to do just what you want? Anyway, 23:49 here - signing off. Good point that some people may find a UTC timestamp more useful than a relative time. EIPIP meeting in 3 hrs. Join Zoom Meeting https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82357016731?pwd=V0hLUWIvU2V2UTdUd216WHdGNFBKUT09 Meeting ID: 823 5701 6731 Passcode: 885372 ~~Coming to meeting today <@543900561460822016>?~~
